items.title: ChatGPT’s New Support for MCP Tools Let Attackers Exfiltrate All Private Details From Email
items.description: A newly introduced feature in ChatGPT that allows it to connect with personal data applications can be exploited by attackers to exfiltrate private information from a user’s email account. The attack requires only the victim’s email address and leverages a malicious calendar invitation to hijack the AI agent.
